sourceContracts.title: Move or rename note
permissionRules: Authenticated owner browser session; /api owner hook returns 401 if absent and 503 during maintenance. Mutations require configured Origin and CSRF token (apps/server/app.ts:141). No administrator/member role split is implemented for these owner surfaces.

fields.name: 目标目录
fields.constraints: Knowledge-library existing folder; root UI guidance says README.md only.

fields.name: 文件名
fields.constraints: Server validName: nonempty, <=180 UTF-8 bytes, no controls / \ :, no leading dot, no trailing space, no . or .., and not AGENTS.md case-insensitively (packages/core/files.ts:20). .md autoappend; legacy .excalidraw retains/autoappends .excalidraw.

actions.label: 确认移动
actions.effect: Preserve identity/history/share links; optimistic version + idempotent request
actions.guard: noteId and nonblank name; !busy; expectedModifiedAt is supplied

actions.label: 取消
actions.guard: Owner session; control-specific guards described in permissionRules.

responsive.behavior: Shared .dialog-card width/min viewport rules and mobile padding apply; exact fit, clipping and focus at target widths remain unverified (apps/web/style.css:783,1271).

sourceContracts.designReason: Existing user-visible surface requires baseline-aligned hierarchy, controls, feedback and responsive treatment without adding behavior.
notes: Source inventory only; no runtime behavior asserted.

actions.label: 创建副本

actions.guard: Loaded baseline required; expectedModifiedAt/contentHash and requestId; !busy/!loading
